samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: In situations related to walking as a daily habit, some routes are difficult to use. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?
requirementsVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp xử lý đúng nguyên nhân.

samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that communities should make everyday walking more convenient, a practical difficulty is that some routes are difficult to use. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

the proposal that

Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that street design may give little attention to people travelling on foot. This can help explain why some routes are difficult to use. Consider the following situation: a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

samples.summaryVi: Biết vài món đơn giản giúp tự chủ ăn uống; công thức nên phù hợp bếp và thời gian thực tế.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that young adults should learn how to prepare a few simple meals, a practical difficulty is that cooking may feel difficult in shared or poorly equipped housing. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

the proposal that

Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that advice may assume that everyone has a large kitchen and plenty of free time. This can help explain why cooking may feel difficult in shared or poorly equipped housing. Consider the following situation: someone sharing one small cooker with several housemates may struggle to prepare a meal at a busy time. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

samples.prompt: In situations related to planning family holidays, trying to satisfy everyone can make the schedule too busy. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?
requirementsVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp xử lý đúng nguyên nhân.
Nêu cách thực hiện và điều kiện.
samples.summaryVi: Cùng bàn giúp tôn trọng nhu cầu từng người; lịch đi cần có ưu tiên và giờ nghỉ.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that families should involve different members when planning a holiday, a practical difficulty is that trying to satisfy everyone can make the schedule too busy. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

the proposal that

parts.text: families should involve different members when planning a holiday, a practical difficulty is that trying to satisfy everyone can make the schedule too busy. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that planners may count activities without considering the time each one requires. This can help explain why trying to satisfy everyone can make the schedule too busy. Consider the following situation: a family may rush between several attractions and finish the day tired rather than pleased. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to choose a small number of priorities and leave room for breaks. For example, family members could each suggest one activity and then agree on a realistic plan with free time. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

samples.prompt: In situations related to getting to know neighbours, some people may feel pressured to join activities. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that neighbourhoods should create simple opportunities for residents to meet, a practical difficulty is that some people may feel pressured to join activities. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that organisers may assume that one type of social event suits everyone. This can help explain why some people may feel pressured to join activities. samples.prompt: In situations related to reading for pleasure, a formal reading target may remove the enjoyment. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that community centres should encourage reading through informal activities, a practical difficulty is that a formal reading target may remove the enjoyment. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

the proposal that

Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that organisers may focus on the number of books rather than the experience of reading. This can help explain why a formal reading target may remove the enjoyment. Consider the following situation: a busy worker may leave a book group because finishing a long novel every week feels like homework. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that young adults should learn to plan their regular spending, a practical difficulty is that a strict plan can fail when unexpected costs appear. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that people may create budgets with no allowance for change. This can help explain why a strict plan can fail when unexpected costs appear.
